fields.FIR_Description: It was alleged that the complainant received an SMS with a link resembling a bank notification; after entering card details on the page, Rs. 75,000 was debited. The matter was brought to Trichy Central PS on 2026-06-16, while the incident was placed on 2026-06-16 around 15:25 hrs. The online submission was made by Deviga Murugan (9000000058). The complainant could not identify the person involved. Transactions from the account SYN-ACC-100092, held by the complainant, were referred to in the complaint. No supporting material was reported at the time of registration.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Fraudulent KYC-update message allegedly used to collect account credentials.
fields.Keywords: phishing, suspicious link, apartment complex, afternoon, bank account
